name: Prisma Angstrum
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: squad of four for more reward picks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

conditions: The kiosk is open even when Baro isn't there, so bank Ducats ahead of his visit; his window is only 48 hours.
Bronze parts are worth 15 ducats, silver 45, gold 100 (25/65 for parts demoted from vaulted relics); 475 is about five gold parts.
bonuses: Cracking the relics already in your inventory is the fastest source.
Capture fissures, or Void Flood and Void Cascade for endless, were named as the fastest; some relics carry a 25- or 45-Ducat part in a bronze slot.

disclosures.title: where not to get ducats
disclosures.body: Aya to Ducats at Varzia during Prime Resurgence is 5 ducats per Aya, a poor rate useful only for topping off.

rows.label: Prisma Angstrum
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or a TennoCon relay visit with Baro's Relay Ticket

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Prisma Angstrum shows up a few times a year at best, with gaps of several months common.
Carry the 210,000 credits too, not just the Ducats.
MR 8 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.

disclosures.title: Incarnon Genesis
disclosures.body: The Angstrum Incarnon Genesis works on the Prisma Angstrum. It comes from the Steel Path Circuit rotation or Cavalero for 120 platinum; installing costs 20 Pathos Clamps, 70 Ueymag and 80 Lamentus. Removing the adapter later doesn't refund the materials.
